question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word in the context of the passage.

Intriguing
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Boring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intriguing"** means something that arouses curiosity or interest; fascinating. (रोचक)
 
 
• **Example:** The detective found the mysterious case very intriguing.
 
 
 
• **"Boring"** refers to something that is not interesting; tedious. (उबाऊ)
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so boring that several students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Intriguing'** is **'Boring'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Boring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stimulating** (उत्तेजक): Encouraging or arousing interest or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** The discussion was highly stimulating and generated a lot of ideas.
 
 
 
• **Crunching** (कुरकुराना): Making a crunching sound, typically when biting into something.
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoyed crunching on the fresh, crisp apples.
 
 
 
• **Torrid** (उष्ण): Very hot and dry.
 
 
• **Example:** They struggled to stay cool during the torrid summer days.
```
